Hippocrates, in describing the robust temperament, tells us that the _athletae_ prepare themselves for the _gymnasium_ by strong exertion, which they continued till they felt fatigue; they then reposed till they felt returning strength and aptitude for labour: and thus, by alternate exercise and indulgence, their limbs acquire the firmest tone of health and vigour.

arxiv-2201-00206.title: Learning Free Gait Transition for Quadruped Robots via Phase-Guided Controller
arxiv-2201-00206.creator: Yecheng Shao, Yongbin Jin, Xianwei Liu, Weiyan He, Hongtao Wang, Wei Yang
arxiv-2201-00206.description: Abstract Gaits and transitions are key components in legged locomotion. For legged robots, describing and reproducing gaits as well as transitions remain longstanding challenges. Reinforcement learning has become a powerful tool to formulate controllers for legged robots. Learning multiple gaits and transitions, nevertheless, is related to the multi-task learning problems.

arxiv-2211-07392.title: FinBERT-LSTM: Deep Learning based stock price prediction using News Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2211-07392.creator: 1 st Shayan Halder
arxiv-2211-07392.description: Abstract Economy is severely dependent on the stock market. An uptrend usually corresponds to prosperity while a downtrend correlates to recession. Predicting the stock market has thus been a centre of research and experiment for a long time. Being able to predict short term movements in the market enables investors to reap greater returns on their investments.

arxiv-2302-12737.title: A Model for Nonthermal Particle Acceleration in Relativistic Magnetic Reconnection Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2302-12737.creator: Xiaocan Li, Fan Guo, Yi-Hsin Liu, Hui Li
arxiv-2302-12737.description: Abstract The past decade has seen an outstanding development of nonthermal particle acceleration in magnetic reconnection in magnetically-dominated systems, with clear signatures of power-law energy distributions as a common outcome of first-principles kinetic simulations. Here we propose a semi-analytical model for systematically investigating nonthermal particle acceleration in reconnection.

arxiv-2303-14033.title: Data-driven estimation of transfer integrals in undoped cuprates
arxiv-2303-14033.creator: Denys Y. Kononenko, Ulrich K. Rößler, Jeroen van den Brink, Oleg Janson
arxiv-2303-14033.description: Abstract Undoped cuprates are an abundant class of magnetic insulators, in which the synergy of rich chemistry and sizable quantum fluctuations leads to a variety of magnetic behaviors. Understanding the magnetism of these materials is impossible without the knowledge of the underlying spin model. The typically dominant antiferromagnetic superexchanges can be accurately estimated from the respective electronic transfer integrals.

arxiv-2307-00876.title: Electron slingshot acceleration in relativistic preturbulent shocks explored via emitted photon polarization
arxiv-2307-00876.creator: Zheng Gong, Xiaofei Shen, Karen Z. Hatsagortsyan, Christoph H. Keitel
arxiv-2307-00876.description: Abstract Transient electron dynamics near the interface of counterstreaming plasmas at the onset of a relativistic collisionless shock (RCS) is investigated using particle-in-cell simulations. We identify a slingshot-like injection process induced by the drifting electric field sustained by the flowing focus of backwards-moving electrons, which is distinct from the well-known stochastic acceleration.

arxiv-2405-09162.title: Complete and Terminating Tableau Calculus for Undirected Graph
arxiv-2405-09162.creator: Yuki Nishimura, Tsubasa Takagi
arxiv-2405-09162.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuki Nishimura, Tsubasa Takagi. Hybrid logic is a modal logic with additional operators specifying nominals and is highly expressive. For example, there is no formula corresponding to the irreflexivity of Kripke frames in basic modal logic, but there is in hybrid logic. Irreflexivity is significant in that irreflexive and symmetric Kripke frames can be regarded as undirected graphs reviewed from a graph theoretic point of view.

arxiv-2408-08212.title: Covert Bias: The Severity of Social Views’ Unalignment in Language Models Towards Implicit and Explicit Opinion
arxiv-2408-08212.creator: Abeer Aldayel, Areej Alokaili, Rehab Alahmadi
arxiv-2408-08212.description: Abstract While various approaches have recently been studied for bias identification, little is known about how implicit language that does not explicitly convey a viewpoint affects bias amplification in large language models. To examine the severity of bias toward a view, we evaluated the performance of two downstream tasks where the implicit and explicit knowledge of social groups were used.

pmc-10549191.title: Diet and gut microbial associations in irritable bowel syndrome according to disease subtype
pmc-10549191.creator: Yiqing Wang, Wenjie Ma, Raaj Mehta, Long H Nguyen, Mingyang Song, David A Drew, Francesco Asnicar, Curtis Huttenhower, Nicola Segata, Jonathan Wolf, Tim Spector, Sarah Berry, Kyle Staller, Andrew T Chan
pmc-10549191.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The role of diet and the gut microbiome in the etiopathogenesis of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is not fully understood. Therefore, we investigated the interplay between dietary risk factors and gut microbiota in IBS subtypes using a food frequency questionnaire and stool metagenome data from 969 participants aged 18–65 years in the ZOE PREDICT 1 study, an intervention study designed to predict postprandial metabolic responses.

pmc-11491448.title: A high-sensitivity flexible bionic tentacle sensor for multidimensional force sensing and autonomous obstacle avoidance applications
pmc-11491448.creator: Xinyu Liu, Kunru Li, Shuo Qian, Lixin Niu, Wei Chen, Hui Wu, Xiaoguang Song, Jie Zhang, Xiaoxue Bi, Junbin Yu, Xiaojuan Hou, Jian He, Xiujian Chou
pmc-11491448.description: Bionic tentacle sensors are important in various fields, including obstacle avoidance, human‒machine interfaces, and soft robotics. However, most traditional tentacle sensors are based on rigid substrates, resulting in difficulty in detecting multidirectional forces originating from the external environment, which limits their application in complex environments. Herein, we proposed a high-sensitivity flexible bionic tentacle sensors (FBTSs).

pmc-12182013.title: Integrating accelerometry, GPS, GIS and molecular data to investigate mechanistic pathways of the urban environmental exposome and cognitive outcomes in older adults: a longitudinal study protocol
pmc-12182013.creator: Ruth F Hunter, Claire Cleland, Mike Trott, Sean O’Neill, Hüseyin Küçükali, Shay Mullineaux, Frank Kee, Jennifer M McKinley, Charlotte Neville, Leeanne O'Hara, Calum Marr, Michael McAlinden, Geraint Ellis, Amy McKnight, Jasper Schipperijn, Joanna McHugh Power, Trung Duong, Bernadette McGuinness
pmc-12182013.description: IntroductionMaintaining cognitive health in later life is a global priority. Encouraging individuals to make health behaviour changes, such as regular physical activity, and providing supportive urban environments can help maintain cognitive health, thereby preventing or delaying the progress of dementia and cognitive decline. However, the mechanistic pathways by which the urban environmental exposome influences cognitive health outcomes are poorly understood.

pmc-12479081.title: Life-Threatening Calcium Chloride Ingestion
pmc-12479081.creator: Ki-Kwan Kang, Hyoung-Jong Kim, Dong-Yoon Kim, Nam-Seon Beck, Sang-Sin Jun, Eun-Mi Jun, Joung-Il Im, Sae-Yong Hong
pmc-12479081.description: Calcium chloride dihydrate (CaCl2·2H2O), a common component in household dehumidifiers in South Korea, poses a significant risk of toxicity upon ingestion. We present a case of life-threatening hypercalcemia following intentional calcium chloride dihydrate ingestion, with a focus on electrolyte homeostasis and physiological adaptation. An 86-year-old Korean woman presented with transient unconsciousness after ingesting dehumidifier fluid.

pmc-12570636.title: Optimization of carbon dioxide insufflation strategies in minimally invasive cardiac surgery: the efficacy of continuous insufflation protocols with left ventricular venting
pmc-12570636.creator: Zhibin Hu, Wenshuai Mao, Lijun Guo, Zhiwei Liu, Xujie Hu, Shuwei Wang, Bing Zhou, Yong Cui
pmc-12570636.description: ObjectivesAlthough CO₂ insufflation play an established role in open-heart surgery, its optimal application in minimally invasive cardiac procedures remains unclear. This study systematically compared continuous versus single CO₂ insufflation protocols during minimally invasive modified morrow procedures, and assessed the influence of left heart venting modality on microbubble clearance efficacy.

pmc-12733262.title: Endocrine Disruption in Freshwater Cladocerans: Transcriptomic Network Perspectives on TBOEP and PFECHS Impacts in Daphnia magna
pmc-12733262.creator: Hyun Woo Kim, Seok-Gyu Yun, Ju Yeon Park, Jun Lee, Jun Pyo Han, Dong Yeop Shin, Jong Hun Lee, Eun-Min Cho, Young Rok Seo
pmc-12733262.description: Freshwater cladocerans such as Daphnia magna (D. magna) are keystone grazers whose hormone-regulated life history traits make them sensitive sentinels of endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs). The organophosphate flame-retardant tris(2-butoxyethyl) phosphate (TBOEP) and perfluoroethylcyclohexane sulfonate (PFECHS) now co-occur at ng L−1–µg L−1 in surface waters, yet their chronic sub-lethal impacts on invertebrate endocrine networks remain unclear.

pmc-13053901.title: Reply: NDM-producing Multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa in Korea: A Growing Threat Requiring National Attention
pmc-13053901.creator: Tark Kim, Yong Pil Chong
pmc-13053901.description: ted between May 2024 and September 2025 were resistant to ceftolozane/tazobactam. Notably, isolates resistant to ceftazidime/avibactam were also resistant to ceftolozane/tazobactam. Among 10 representative MRPA isolates resistant to ceftolozane/tazobactam, blaNDM was detected in all strains. These findings further support the increasing predominance of New Delhi metallo-β-lactamase (NDM)-producing high-risk strains among MRPA isolates in Korea.

pmc-13248891.title: A homozygous CTLA-4 variant causes CTLA-4 deficiency with severe immune dysregulation
pmc-13248891.creator: Mehmet Cihangir Catak, Salim Can, Satanay Hubrack, Feyza Bayram Catak, Asha Elmi, Royala Babayeva, Razin Amirov, Melek Yorgun Altunbas, Sevgi Bilgic Eltan, Deniz Ertem, Baris Yilmaz, Ahmet Koc, Batu Erman, Emine Bozkurtlar, Elif Karakoc-Aydiner, Ahmet Ozen, Bernice Lo, Safa Baris
pmc-13248891.description: Catak et al. describe the first case of homozygous CTLA-4 deficiency, which drives severe early-onset autoimmunity through profound T and B cell dysregulation. They show that the variant impairs protein stability, yet targeted therapy with abatacept successfully restores immune balance, highlighting new clinical strategies for CTLA-4–related disorders.

pmc-13541956.creator: Adas Cepas, Paavo Saarela, Tuomas Komulainen, Tero Järvinen, Juha Kiiski, Ilkka Kaartinen
pmc-13541956.description: BackgroundTotal paucity exists on how large human blood vessels respond to ischemia. We explored the human vascular response to trauma-induced ischemia, with a particular focus on vascular wall remodelling.MethodsArterial and venous wall samples were analysed from 40 patients undergoing soft tissue free flap reconstruction following lower extremity trauma.

pmc-13577261.title: Integrated metagenomic and metabolomic analysis identifies severity-specific inflammatory and metabolic signatures in post-stroke depression
pmc-13577261.creator: Wenyi Chen, Yawen Pan, Mengyuan Chen, Shanshan Zhou, Xiaodie Liu, Mengjiao Sun, Zixuan Yang, Yinghao Zhi
pmc-13577261.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Post-stroke depression (PSD) is a common complication that significantly impacts patient prognosis. This study aimed to systematically characterize the associations among gut microbial ecology, metabolic profiles, and inflammatory responses across different severities of PSD. We conducted metagenomic sequencing, non-targeted metabolomics, and serum cytokine analysis (IL-1β, IL-6, IL-10, IL-18, TNF-α, IFN-γ, and CRP) in 91 patients with varying degrees of PSD and non-PSD controls. Bioinformatics analyzes were employed to construct multi-omics association networks and machine learning models.
